Hotset zero-token every cycle today — 301 zero cycles, last non-zero 03:58 (77 min consecutive).

Root cause sharpened this cycle from signal-compactor.log 05:15-05:16 (verified, not copied): it is a band-mismatch AND queue deadlock, two failures stacked. (1) Generators emit OUTSIDE approval bands: 6h expired SHORTs avg meta-time RSI 40.1 (below SHORT_RSI_HARD_FLOOR=45), expired LONGs avg 67.1 (hugging ceiling 75). Neo SHORT died at RSI 40 floor; DOT SHORT died at SPIKE-FILTER RSI 13.3 and R:R 0.69; ONDO SHORT died at BTC-CHOP-GATE (MOMENTUM type, BTC flat). (2) In-band signals still die: 29 of the 76 expired shorts had RSI >= 45 and expired anyway — PENDING queue holds 4-5 signals that must reach top-10 while hotset is empty, then expire at 5 min. Pre-filter now passes 1-2 (was 0 at 04:47) but downstream kills them before top-10. Gates are mostly protecting us; nothing valid is being generated in-band.

Right side: with 0 trades we hold no side, and the closed data keeps saying the winning side is SHORT — 24h SHORT 13T 8W +0.31 vs LONG 7T 1W -0.39 (re-verified PG 05:17); 7d SHORT 38T +0.56 vs LONG 82T -1.73. Meanwhile inventory emits 2.2x more longs. But this cycle no short was pickable: all 8 short candidates prechecked sat at 1m RSI 10-30 (falling knife, hard-blocked) because the dumps already happened — shorting down there is the BANANA mistake. The only gate-valid setup today was a LONG in an independently uptrending coin: USUAL LONG, RSI 60.0 center band, +0.49%/30m, all 10 precheck checks pass. Written as watchlist-only (AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False) — will NOT execute.

Auto-trader shadow backs the chop read: 8 trades all CHOP, shorts 3/4 +0.123 vs longs 0/4 -0.11; two armed brackets aged 360 min (short trigger 80522 / long 81537, price 80851 between them).
